b: Elements by Hardware Resources has introduced the Brewer Collection, a minimalist T-pull series that combines clean architectural lines with understated sophistication.

Featuring a streamlined rectangular profile, the Brewer Collection draws on contemporary architectural influences to complement modern and industrial-inspired interiors. Designed to balance form and function, the collection delivers a subtle yet distinctive design statement for kitchens, baths, and other residential spaces.

Available in five versatile finishes, the Brewer Collection offers seven pull sizes to suit a variety of applications. Options range from a compact 1-3/4″ pull that can serve as a knob alternative to a 20-inch pull designed for wide drawers and tall cabinet doors.
To learn more about the Brewer Collection and view the complete line of Elements decorative hardware, visit hardwareresources.com.
